description:
Ada hubungan langsung antara kualitas dokumentasi event dan kekuatan employer branding perusahaan. Hampir tidak ada yang membicarakannya.

Kandidat terbaik meneliti perusahaan sebelum melamar. Mereka tidak hanya membaca deskripsi pekerjaan. Mereka mencari foto tim, suasana kantor, dan bagaimana perusahaan menampilkan dirinya di acara internal.

Perusahaan yang mendokumentasikan event dengan baik, annual dinner, town hall, program onboarding, secara tidak langsung membangun perpustakaan employer branding yang bekerja sepanjang tahun.

Perusahaan yang tidak mendokumentasikan membiarkan kandidat menyimpulkan sendiri.

Apakah tim HR kamu menggunakan foto event untuk keperluan rekrutmen? Jika ya, momen apa yang paling sering dipakai?

---

There is a direct link between the quality of a company's event documentation and the strength of its employer brand. Almost no one talks about it.

Top candidates research companies before applying. They do not just read the job description. They look for team photos, office atmosphere, and how the company presents itself at internal events.

Companies that document their events well, annual dinners, town halls, onboarding programs, build an employer branding library that works throughout the year without additional effort.

Companies that do not document leave candidates to draw their own conclusions.

Does your HR team use event photos for recruitment purposes, and if so, which moments tend to be most useful?

Planning a corporate event? If you need photo/video with clear delivery standards and fast turnaround, message us. We'll share a sample shot list and a clear turnaround timeline.
